partnerships.scope: Pfizer licensed Axsome exclusive U.S. rights to reboxetine (AXS-12) data and intellectual property and exclusive U.S. development and commercialization rights to esreboxetine (AXS-14).
Axsome acquired SUNOSI (solriamfetol) rights in the territories then held by Jazz, subject to continuing U.S. sales royalties to Jazz.
Axsome exclusively licensed Pharmanovia SUNOSI development and commercialization rights in Europe and certain Middle East and North African markets while retaining manufacturing responsibilities.
SK retains solriamfetol rights in 12 Asian markets, including China, Korea and Japan; Axsome assumed Jazz's SUNOSI royalty commitments to SK.
Axsome assumed royalty commitments to Aerial associated with the earlier license of solriamfetol rights that Axsome acquired from Jazz.
Axsome holds exclusive licenses from Antecip covering intellectual property used in its AXS-05 program.
Axsome obtained worldwide AZD7325 (AXS-17) rights through its acquisition of Baergic Bio, which had originally licensed the asset from AstraZeneca.
Axsome acquired global rights to balipodect (AXS-20) from Takeda, which remains eligible for development and sales milestones and royalties.
